definitions.gloss: sports club; athletics club (at a school)
definitions.explanation: A school extracurricular club for a sport such as baseball, soccer, tennis, or kendo. One of the two big categories of Japanese school clubs, alongside {文化部|ぶんかぶ} (cultural clubs).

examples.japanese: {運動部|うんどうぶ}に{入|はい}っている。
{弟|おとうと}は{運動部|うんどうぶ}で{毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}している。
examples.english: My younger brother practices every day in a sports club.

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}{時代|じだい}は{運動部|うんどうぶ}に{所属|しょぞく}していて、{毎日|まいにち}{遅|おそ}くまで{練習|れんしゅう}していた。
examples.english: In junior high I belonged to a sports club and practiced late every day.

notes:
{運動|うんどう} (exercise; sport) + {部|ぶ} (club). A general term covering any sports-based school club. In casual speech students may also say {体育会系|たいいくかいけい} for the same idea, especially when contrasting with cultural clubs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運動部|うんどうぶ}に{入|はい}る: to join a sports club
- {運動部|うんどうぶ}に{所属|しょぞく}する: to belong to a sports club
- {運動部|うんどうぶ}の{練習|れんしゅう}: sports club practice
- {運動部|うんどうぶ}の{先輩|せんぱい}: senior members of a sports club

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文化部|ぶんかぶ}: cultural club — the contrasting category (music, art, science, etc.)
- {部活|ぶかつ}: club activity — the activity itself, regardless of type
- {体育会系|たいいくかいけい}: of the athletics persuasion — describes the strict, hierarchical culture of sports clubs
